name: Modified JPEG2000 for Tiled Pyramid
definition: A modified JPEG2000 compression scheme adapted for tiled pyramid terrain visualization. It modifies the image tiling process and wavelet transform application to allow efficient transmission and reconstruction of terrain data using tiled pyramids.
summary: Modified JPEG2000 for Tiled Pyramid is a compression scheme for terrain visualization that prevents boundary artifacts by using identical coefficients for analysis and synthesis.
